comparison.objective: Remove diagonal cutters from a crowded pegboard; the candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Occluded tool grasping, peg clearance, and extraction from clutter, not coupled screw/nut torque.
comparison.success_condition: Cutters must clear the pegboard and be safely retained/released per the rubric; candidate grades stop setting and cycling.
comparison.reason: Both use tools, but retrieval from pegs does not test tool-mediated adjustment.
